Subject: Commit slab validation + procurement lane for LumenAI

Alex / Lumen procurement team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the two asks we agreed on during the call: 

1) Budget slab & volumes (we discussed three candidate monthly corridors):
   - Low: 10–30M tokens/mo
   - Mid: 30–120M tokens/mo
   - High: 120–400M tokens/mo
   We need confirmation which corridor maps to your expected GA usage so we can lock a commit slab and pricing.

2) Procurement threshold & timing: you mentioned PO minimums and internal approval gates (approx $50k PO threshold; monthly/quarterly cadence). Confirm the PO threshold that would trigger a reserved capacity contract versus a monthly pay-as-you-go flow.

Attached: LumenAI_usage_estimate.xlsx — rough projection we filled during the call.

Pricing baseline we discussed on-call (ballpark): $750–1,800 per 1M tokens depending on commit & reserve level. Karthik will follow up with three explicit tiered proposals and the corresponding procurement path for each.

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm the likely monthly slab (pick the closest corridor) and PO threshold your procurement team requires.
- Procurement: confirm required vendor paperwork and expected PO lead time.
- Karthik/Monica/Vivek: draft a short SOW and tiered pricing to send for internal review (we'll include the SOW_draft_v1.pdf once ready).

Thanks — aim to get your confirmation by EOD Monday so we can prepare the SOW and pricing table for procurement review.

— Vivek

Thanks Vivek — good recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- Likely slab: Mid (30–120M tokens/mo). We expect a ramp: 30M in month 1 of GA, ~80–100M by month 3, stabilizing in the mid corridor.
- Procurement threshold: our PO system flags anything over $50,000 for additional CFO approval; below that procurement can issue a PO without CFO sign-off. Typical lead time for approved POs is ~7–10 business days.

A couple of clarifying questions for pricing: can you confirm the $/1M token figure that corresponds to the Mid commit (30–120M)? Also, does Redwood offer monthly reserved capacity with the option to true-up at quarter end?

Cc'ing procurement to answer the vendor paperwork timeline.

Alex — appreciate the clear slab guidance. Below is a concise proposal we can use for procurement & SOW. I attached a very short SOW draft for procurement review (SOW_draft_v1.pdf).

Tiered pricing options (per 1M tokens, post-discount):
- Option A (Monthly Flex): $1,800 / 1M | No commit, pay-as-you-go, ideal for <= 30M/mo
- Option B (Mid Commit): $1,050 / 1M | 3-month rolling commit equivalent to 45–120M/mo; includes 10% reserved capacity discount and priority burst lanes
- Option C (Reserved Capacity): $750 / 1M | 12-month reserved pool, up-front commit, includes lower preemption risk, extended SLA and capacity guarantees

True-up & billing: For Option B we offer quarter-end true-up — if actual usage exceeds committed slab, overage billed at the Option B overage rate ($1,350 / 1M) or rolled into a reserve for the next quarter if both parties agree.

Procurement path notes: 
- If PO >= $50k: route through Contracts + Finance (standard 7–10 business days).
- If PO < $50k: Procurement can issue directly after receipt of SOW and PO form (2–4 business days).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321 — I added pricing tables and the SOW draft.

I'll stand up a one-page pricing appendix that maps your projected month-by-month token run-rate (from the attached usage_estimate) to the three options so procurement can see expected monthly cost by slab. Expect that appendix by EOD today.

— Karthik
